title: Last Visited Cell in a Directional Grid
statement: The task is to follow arrows (L/R/U/D) from cell (0,0) of an m x n grid, with m*n up to 10^5, stopping when the next move would leave the grid or re-enter a visited cell, and to return the last visited cell. A direct simulation with a visited matrix works because each step reaches a new cell, so the walk takes at most m*n steps.
